name: Destroy Grandma
desc:
New Summer Camp MAP, New Skins, New tools and more!🚤

Granny has to complete her daily tasks but the children have different plans!

🎮 CONTROLS:

PC: E to pick up items, F to kick as grandma, Hold LMB to throw your items.
Mobile: Click to pickup items, Click on kid to kick them, Click to throw
Console: X to pick up items, L3 to sprint, R2 to throw.

👍Please LIKE the game and JOIN the GROUP for exclusive rewards!

❤️ Made by Slungpy and 404problems
